text:
sam (DevEx): quick design check — updated modal for schema assistant (tool-calling). reworded primary button from 'Save & Close' to 'Apply schema', added a compact preview area. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/schema-modal-v2.png

liz (Design): :eyes: looks cleaner. two quick things: primary copy maybe 'Apply schema' is okay but could be confusing for users who expect 'Save'. can we make the tertiary 'Close' and secondary 'Preview' instead of 'Cancel'?

omar (Eng): i agree with liz on button hierarchy. also, keyboard focus is weird when you open the preview — focus jumps to the preview close button instead of the first input. reproducer: open modal -> Tab -> focus should go to first field.

kevin (A11y): thanks for flagging keyboard. needs aria-modal and focus trap. also aria-live=\"polite\" for the live validation errors so screenreader users get feedback when schema parse fails. current build has no live region.

matt (DevEx): noted — current JS puts focus on the preview container for a11y reasons, we can tweak to focus the first schema input when modal opens and move focus to preview when the user explicitly opens preview.

sam (DevEx): quick copy suggestion: primary 'Apply schema' -> 'Apply schema changes' (more explicit). secondary 'Preview' -> 'Preview validation' to indicate it runs validation. tertiary 'Close' stays.

liz (Design): +1 for 'Apply schema changes' but it’s getting long. maybe abbreviate to 'Apply changes' and context above header says 'Schema assistant — changes to tool def'.

kevin (A11y): language nit: avoid ambiguous verbs. 'Apply changes' is okay. Also add visible focus ring that doesn't rely on color only (outline + box-shadow). Use 3:1 contrast for focus indicators for small UI controls.

omar (Eng): implementation note: the preview runs validation async and shows line highlights. if we put aria-live=\"polite\" it might announce a lot. recommend announce a summary only: \"Validation: 2 errors, 1 warning\" and then users can navigate to details.

sam (DevEx): good point — announce summary first then details expandable. also can we debounce validation announcements to avoid rapid chattiness when typing?

kevin (A11y): yes debounce to 700ms is fine. also ensure errors are reachable in DOM order after the input they correspond to.

liz (Design): layout question — run history link in the modal header feels heavy. what if we move 'Open run history' into the kebab menu on the modal so header stays clean?

matt (DevEx): moving to kebab ok. but run history is often needed after preview so maybe show a small inline link under the preview summary: 'View run history' so both paths exist.

sam (DevEx): proposed action items: 1) rename primary to 'Apply changes' 2) move run history to kebab + inline under preview summary 3) focus trap fix (focus first input) 4) aria-live summary + debounce 5) visible non-color focus ring. who volunteers for PR?

omar (Eng): I can take the focus trap + debounce validation announcements.

liz (Design): I’ll update copy and header visuals, and mock the kebab changes.

kevin (A11y): I’ll write the a11y checklist for the modal and check the contrast/focus specs.

matt (DevEx): I’ll add the 'View run history' inline wireflow and add a tiny tooltip for the kebab menu explaining where run history lives.

sam (DevEx): awesome. can we aim for a tiny ship tomorrow for the a11y + focus fix? omar, kevin — if you can land the quick fixes first, we can merge and then do copy tweak in follow-up.

omar (Eng): yep will prioritize focus trap + announcement patch.

kevin (A11y): I’ll review the PR quickly.

liz (Design): small visual nit — when schema errors highlight lines, add a subtle background (not red fill) and an icon on the gutter so color not sole indicator.

sam (DevEx): noted. added to checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
